b3_defects.description: desk_01 is overlapping and physically intersecting with cabinet_01.
lamp_01 (floor lamp) appears to be floating or hovering significantly above the floor mat on top of a desk rather than standing upright in its intended corner spot near monitor_01.

worst_object.reason: The desktop monitor is positioned at an impossible height relative to the books and laptop stand, suggesting it should be attached to a wall or shelf structure but lacks connection points. Furthermore, the lamp_01 model associated with this view appears floating in mid-air on top of the desk without supporting legs extending to the floor.

comment: The scene fails as a cohesive room because key furniture items like the monitor and its associated lighting fixtures are placed in physically impossible configurations. The overlap between objects combined with floating geometry creates visual artifacts that break immersion despite good texture quality.
